<user_query>
Explore C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell for UI polish gaps, incomplete features, and quick wins. Focus on src/renderer/src/components and related lib files. Look for: TODO/FIXME comments, emoji in UI that should be icons, missing aria labels, inconsistent styling (#hex vs shell tokens), broken empty states, missing testids, stale HUD, keyboard shortcut gaps, onboarding/readiness polish, command palette, mission control, toasts, loading states. Return a prioritized list of 8-12 concrete fixes with exact file paths and what to change. Be specific - not generic advice.
</user_query>

Searching the renderer components and related libs for TODO/FIXME, accessibility gaps, styling inconsistencies, and incomplete UI patterns.

[REDACTED]

I scanned `src/renderer/src/components`, related libs (`bootstrap/operatorPalette.js`, `state/moduleRegistry.js`, `utils/appToast.js`, `lib/workpadStore.js`), and keyboard handling in `App.jsx`. There are **no TODO/FIXME comments** in the renderer tree — gaps show up as incomplete wiring and inconsistent polish instead.

## Prioritized UI polish fixes (12)

### 1. Command palette shortcuts are wrong in help and in the palette UI
**Priority: P0 — breaks discoverability**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\state\moduleRegistry.js`** (~line 154): Help text says `` `Ctrl+P` : Open Command Palette `` but the app opens palette with **Ctrl+K** (`App.jsx` ~1798).
- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx`** (~line 2210): Same stale shortcut in the `/help` operator guide string — update to `Ctrl+K`, and document `Ctrl+Shift+T` (Inbox) / `Ctrl+Shift+N` (Workpad).
- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\CommandPalette.jsx`** (~lines 110–123): `commandItems` **overwrites** registry shortcuts with positional `Ctrl+1…9`. Change to:
  ```js
  shortcut: cmd.shortcut || (index < 9 ? `${mod} + ${index + 1}` : ''),
  ```
  so `operatorPalette.js` entries like “Open Operator Inbox · Ctrl+Shift+T” actually render.
- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MultiWorkspace.jsx`** (~876–884): Ctrl+P opens **Projects**, not palette — document that explicitly to avoid collision.

---

### 2. Ctrl+K can close the palette while you’re typing in it
**Priority: P0 — keyboard bug**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\CommandPalette.jsx`** (~line 290): Add `data-testid="command-palette-input"` on the search `<input>`.
- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx`** (~1761): Extend `isTypingTarget` to include `command-palette-input` (only `chat-input` and `slash-palette-input` are whitelisted today). Alternatively, skip `togglePalette()` when `showPalette` is already true.

---

### 3. Readiness checklist modal is missing modal UX basics
**Priority: P0 — first-run polish**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\ReadinessChecklistModal.jsx`**:
  - Wire `useModalAccessibility(open, ref, onClose)` (pattern used in `LLMRulesPanel.jsx`).
  - Add `onKeyDown` Esc → `onClose`.
  - Add testids: `readiness-checklist-skip-btn`, `readiness-checklist-run-health-btn`, `readiness-checklist-run-bridge-btn`.
  - `CheckRow` buttons need `aria-label={`Run ${label}`}`.
  - On open, hydrate `healthOk`/`bridgeOk` from last `window.api.system.healthHistory()` / bridge test so progress isn’t lost mid-checklist.
- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx`** (~1831 Escape block): Add `if (showReadinessChecklist) setShowReadinessChecklist(false)` — readiness is **not** closed by Escape today.

---

### 4. App toast host is minimal and untestable
**Priority: P1 — operator feedback**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\AppToastHost.jsx`**:
  - Add `data-testid="app-toast-message"` on the visible message node.
  - Add a dismiss button (`aria-label="Dismiss notification"`) — currently toasts auto-hide only; rapid errors overwrite each other.
  - Consider a 2–3 item queue instead of single `{ message, tone }` state.
- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\utils\appToast.js`**: No change needed; consumers already dispatch correctly.

---

### 5. UserHud shows stale model and hides Operator Inbox when idle
**Priority: P1 — stale HUD**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\UserHud.jsx`**:
  - ~line 89: Replace hardcoded `'llama3'` fallback with `'—'` or `'not set'` when `pane?.model` and `connectionInfo?.model` are empty.
  - ~lines 19–31 `PanelIconButton`: Add `aria-label={title}` (only `title` today — insufficient for SR).
  - ~lines 131–144: Activity chip only renders when `activeTaskCount + workpadOpenCount > 0`. Always show a muted “Inbox” icon button (badge when counts > 0) so Operator Inbox is reachable from the HUD when idle.
  - Add `data-testid` on panel toggles: `user-hud-panel-voice`, `user-hud-panel-workpad`, etc.

---

### 6. Top status bar: emoji settings icon + missing aria labels
**Priority: P1 — quick visual/a11y win**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\TopStatusBar.jsx`**:
  - ~lines 270–297: Back/forward buttons have `title` but no `aria-label`.
  - ~lines 342–350: Model `<select>` needs `aria-label="Active model"`.
  - ~lines 374–379: `EXEC` button needs `aria-label="Open command palette (Ctrl+K)"` — label is cryptic for SR users.
  - ~lines 471–477: Replace emoji `⚙` with `Settings` from `lucide-react` (Moon/Sun already imported on line 2) for consistency with the rest of the chrome.

---

### 7. Agent mode dropdown uses emoji labels
**Priority: P1 — emoji → icons/text**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MultiWorkspace.jsx`** (~lines 78–87, ~502–505):
  - `AGENT_MODES` uses `🔍 Analyze`, `💻 Code`, etc.
  - Change labels to plain text (`Analyze`, `Code`, …) or a custom dropdown with lucide icons (Search, Code2, FlaskConical, Eye, Rocket, BarChart2, FileText).
  - Add `aria-label="Agent mode"` on the `<select>`.

---

### 8. Workpad empty states use the wrong icon and break in the note sidebar
**Priority: P1 — broken empty states**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\Workpad\WorkpadPanel.jsx`**:
  - ~lines 117–135 `EmptyState`: Always renders `IconNotes` even for Tasks/Pins/Capture tabs (~824, ~888, ~975).
  - Add an `icon` prop (map tab → `IconTasks` / `IconPins` / `IconLog`).
  - ~lines 641–647: Full `EmptyState` (py-12 + 48px icon) inside the **9.5rem** note sidebar — replace with a compact inline empty row (`text-[10px] text-slate-500 px-2 py-4`) so search-no-match doesn’t overflow.
  - ~lines 569–576 close button: add `aria-label="Close workpad"`.

---

### 9. Provider sweep: no loading skeleton or empty list state
**Priority: P2 — settings loading polish**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\ProviderSweep.jsx`** (~lines 94–119):
  - When `providerSweepBusy && !providerSweepRows.length`, show 3 pulsing placeholder rows (`animate-pulse`).
  - When `!providerSweepBusy && providerSweepRows.length === 0`, show dashed empty state: “No provider results — click Refresh to run a sweep” with `data-testid="settings-provider-sweep-empty"`.
  - Button already toggles “Checking” (~line 44) but the list area stays blank.

---

### 10. LLM Rules panel category chips use emoji
**Priority: P2 — emoji → icons**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\LLMRulesPanel.jsx`** (~lines 8–12, ~134, ~166):
  - Category meta uses `dot: '🧠'`, `'📐'`, `'🎙️'`, etc.
  - Replace `dot` with lucide icon components (Brain, Ruler, Mic, Drama, Ban) like `AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` already does for presets.
  - Header `⚙️` (~134) → lucide `Settings`.

---

### 11. UIAppearanceCard uses raw hex instead of shell tokens
**Priority: P2 — styling consistency**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\Settings\UIAppearanceCard.jsx`** (~line 71):
  - `bg-[#1e1e2e]/40` → `bg-shell-soft/40` or `bg-black/30` to match `SettingsDrawer.jsx` / `TaskManagerDrawer.jsx` (`bg-shell-deep/98`, `bg-shell-soft/60`).
- Same file ~line 149: accent placeholder `#22D3EE` is fine for a color input, but preview swatches should read `var(--accent)` via `useAccent()` for live sync.

Related: **`ChatSummaryBar.jsx`** (~94–100) and **`UserHud.jsx`** (~48) still hardcode `#8b5cf6`, `#D97757`, etc. — migrate to `moodEngine.colors` / CSS vars in a follow-up.

---

### 12. Operator Inbox / Mission Control: close buttons and empty-state testids
**Priority: P2 — a11y + e2e**

- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\TaskManagerDrawer.jsx`**:
  - ~530–537: Close button has `data-testid` but no `aria-label="Close operator inbox"`.
  - ~85–87 Workpad tab empty: add `data-testid="operator-inbox-workpad-empty"`.
  - ~164–166 Health tab empty: add `data-testid="operator-inbox-health-empty"`.
  - ~151 Health “Run health check now” button: add `data-testid="operator-inbox-run-health-btn"`.
  - ~695 Missions empty: add `data-testid="operator-inbox-missions-empty"`.
- **`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MissionControl.jsx`** (~570–577): Close `✕` → lucide `X` + `aria-label="Close mission control"`.

---

## Honorable mentions (next batch)

| Area | File | Issue |
|------|------|-------|
| SmartSuggest loading/dismiss | `SmartSuggest.jsx` | `✦` / `✕` without aria-labels; no `data-testid`; suggestions not keyboard-focusable |
| Streaming bar visibility | `StreamingBar.jsx` | Returns `null` when `prefers-reduced-motion` — no static “Streaming…” text fallback |
| Onboarding rail | `OnboardingProgressRail.jsx` | Reopen/Reset buttons lack `aria-label`; no link to readiness checklist |
| Slash vs command palette | `SlashPalette.jsx` vs `CommandPalette.jsx` | Two palette UIs; only slash input has `slash-palette-input` testid |

---

## Suggested fix order

1. Shortcut docs + palette shortcut wiring (items 1–2)  
2. Readiness modal + toast UX (items 3–4)  
3. HUD / status bar / agent modes (items 5–7)  
4. Workpad empty states + provider sweep loading (items 8–9)  
5. Emoji/token cleanup + inbox testids (items 10–12)

If you want these implemented, switch to Agent mode and I can land them as a focused PR series (shortcuts/readiness first, then HUD/a11y).
